_schema: Curated concept-profile registry for the Concept Atlas. Measured attributes (reach, role, degree, betweenness, signature partners, family) are computed at runtime by build_atlas; THIS file holds the curated, grounded UNDERSTANDING. To add a concept, add an entry keyed by its rasm root (Book6 forms, e.g. ک/ی). Fields: display, family, structural_type, reading{form_content, grammar_semantics, structure_function}, senses[], universe_analog, status(draft|reviewed), closeup_page(optional). Tag claims [TEXT]/[INFERENCE] inside the reading. Un-listed concepts render measured-only — the atlas is always complete and deepens as entries are filled.

reading.form_content: [TEXT] root ق-ل-ب = both the organ 'heart' and the verb 'to turn / overturn' — the heart is named as the TURNING faculty; its states are how it has turned.
reading.grammar_semantics: [INFERENCE] morphology splits senses the lexicon blurs: قلب-organ vs قلب 'to turn'; auto-clustering misses this, so senses must be read morphologically.
reading.structure_function: [TEXT] co-referent with صدر and فؤاد as ONE organ-system; states attach SELECTIVELY — constriction ضیق·حرج occur 0× with قلب, only with صدر (organ-specific selectivity).

قلب.universe_analog: anatomy — graded states of an organ

reading.form_content: [TEXT] the breast/chest as the container of the heart; what is 'in the breasts' (ما في الصدور) = the inmost.
reading.grammar_semantics: [INFERENCE] carries the SPATIAL states the heart-organ does not: expansion (شرح) vs constriction (ضیق/حرج).
reading.structure_function: [TEXT] the constriction/expansion POLE of the heart-system; ضیق·حرج attach here, not to قلب — the measured organ-specific selectivity.

reading.form_content: [INFERENCE] fuʾād from a root of kindling/burning — the heart as the faculty of focused attention/perception.
reading.grammar_semantics: [TEXT] paired with hearing and sight (السمع والأبصار والأفئدة) — the perceptual triad.
reading.structure_function: [TEXT] third co-referent of the heart-system (قلب·صدر·فؤاد); the faculty held accountable for what it pursues.

reading.form_content: [TEXT] root ر-ح-م = the WOMB (رَحِم); mercy (رَحْمة) is womb-shaped — enclosing, gestating, provisioning — not mere pity; kinship-ties (الأرحام) are named from it.
reading.grammar_semantics: [TEXT] الرَّحْمٰن (faʿlān = overflowing, cosmic, near-proper-name of God) vs الرَّحِيم (faʿīl = constant, particular, even of the Prophet 9:128) — same root, the PATTERN encodes the SCOPE.
reading.structure_function: [MEASURED+INFERENCE] a GRADIENT over a shared recipient field, not a partition — mercy reaches every recipient type (even disbelief, 19×); operates through forgiveness غفر and repentance توب; the threshold of the text (Basmala opens 113/114 sūras). [MEASURED] encompasses all things without exception (7:156, 40:7); a graded scale with God at the apex أرحم/خير الراحمين (6×); 113 āyāt close on رحيم — mercy is the resolving cadence (غفور رحيم 49×).

رحم.universe_analog: physics — an ambient field; anatomy — the womb

reading.form_content: [TEXT · MEASURED] the noun نور is ALWAYS singular (43×; plural أنوار 0×) while darkness is ALWAYS plural ظلمات (23×; singular ظلمة 0×) — the form itself says one light, many darknesses.
reading.grammar_semantics: [TEXT · MEASURED] the salvific motion is fixed in the prepositions مِنَ الظُّلُمَاتِ إِلَى النُّورِ (out of the many, into the one) — 7×; the single reversal light→dark (2:257) is marked as the ṭāghūt's work.
reading.structure_function: [TEXT+INFERENCE] light is never self-attained — it is BROUGHT (by God, the Book, Moses, the Prophet سراجاً منيراً); light = guidance = the one straight path (5:16, 14:1); its singularity meets God's Oneness الواحد (13:16); light=life vs death=darkness (6:122).

senses: light-giver منير — the Book / moon / Prophet

حرم.display: ḥarām / ḥalāl — the forbidden & the sacred

reading.form_content: [TEXT] the root ح-ر-م means BOTH 'forbidden' and 'sacred / inviolable' (المسجد الحرام 15×, الأشهر الحرم 5×, حرماً آمناً) — the concept is named after the BOUNDARY: to make ḥarām is to fence off.
reading.grammar_semantics: [TEXT · MEASURED] the two operators are passive — حُرِّم عليكم / أُحِلَّ لكم (9× each); the forbidden is an ENUMERATED closed list, the lawful the open default — 'I find nothing forbidden except…' (6:145).
reading.structure_function: [TEXT] one legitimate Author — only God draws the line; private permitting/forbidding = fabrication against God (16:116, 10:59, 66:1); the line tracks ṭayyib (good) vs khabīth (impure) — 7:157, ḥalālan ṭayyiban 5×.

senses: the sacred / inviolable — Mosque · months · town
حرم.universe_analog: law / set theory — a bounded domain (default region + marked exception)

سمو.structural_type: frozen pair / merism (heaven ↔ earth = the whole)

reading.form_content: [TEXT · MEASURED] the pair is FROZEN in order — السماوات والأرض 147× vs the reverse 2× (both contextually motivated, 14:48 · 20:4); and in number — heavens plural/seven (سبع سماوات 7×) but earth NEVER plural (أرضين 0×): up is many, down is one.
reading.grammar_semantics: [TEXT · MEASURED] naming the two poles is a MERISM for totality — خلق السماوات والأرض 29×, ما في السماوات والأرض 38×, وما بينهما ('and what is between them') 21× spells out that the pair brackets ALL creation.
reading.structure_function: [TEXT+INFERENCE] the concept is the BRACKET, not the endpoints — heaven/earth is the scope-word for God's creating/owning/knowing ('to God belongs whatever is in the heavens and the earth', 38×); the fixed order encodes cosmic hierarchy (heaven prior/above).

senses: 'and what is between them' — the bracketed whole
سمو.universe_analog: cosmology — a vertical axis named by its two extremes (a merism for the cosmos)

سحر.structural_type: counterfeit / adversarial mirror of the sign

reading.form_content: [TEXT · MEASURED] siḥr is mostly what deniers SAY — 44/59 sorcery-verses carry قول 'to say'; the formula سِحْرٌ مُبِين 'clear sorcery' (9×) is hurled at Moses, Jesus and Muhammad alike — the exact mirror of بيّنة/مبين 'clear proof' (same adjective, opposite verdict).
reading.grammar_semantics: [TEXT] the Qurʾān has NO word معجزة (0×; root عجز = 'to frustrate/escape'); its sign-vocabulary is آية (382) · بيّنة (523) · برهان (8). 'muʿjiza' is post-Qurʾānic. The real pair is āyah (sign) ↔ siḥr (its counterfeit).
reading.structure_function: [TEXT+INFERENCE] siḥr is built to be CONFUSABLE with the sign (both extraordinary); the text separates them by four differentiators — source (devil-taught 2:102 vs by-God's-leave), ontology (illusion of the eyes 7:116, 20:66 vs real), outcome (never prospers 20:69, nullified 10:81, swallowed 7:117), and the experts' verdict (the magicians themselves prostrate, 26:46·7:120·20:70).

سحر.universe_analog: epistemology / forensics — telling a genuine from a counterfeit by hidden markers
